name: Sonikoma — AI Webtoon Motion Comic & Video Automation Studio
tagline: Transform static Webtoons & Manga into cinematic motion comics, AI-dubbed shorts, and viral videos in seconds.
description: An end-to-end AI-powered creative engine and automated production suite for webtoon & manga creators. Automates multi-source comic scraping, dual-core OpenCV + YOLOv8 spatial panel segmentation, AI speech bubble OCR, neural text-to-speech dialogue dubbing, and multi-track Remotion video rendering with automated social media publishing presets.

features.name: Universal Comic & Webtoon Scraper
features.description: Headless and dynamic chapter scraping across major webtoon portals with automatic image decryption and caching.

features.name: Dual-Core Spatial Vision Engine
features.description: Hybrid OpenCV contour clustering + YOLOv8 neural segmentation for automated panel slicing and speech bubble isolation.

features.name: AI Neural Dialogue & Voice Dubber
features.description: Multi-engine OCR with character voice assignment and multilingual TTS (Edge-TTS, ElevenLabs, Gemini Audio).

features.name: Pro Multi-Track Timeline Video Editor
features.description: Full-featured web studio powered by Remotion, Fabric.js, and Three.js supporting keyframes, transitions, and audio mixing.

features.name: Chrome Manifest V3 Companion Extension
features.description: SidePanel mini-studio, live in-browser speech bubble reader, 1-click chapter archiver, and 9:16 Shorts panel snipper.

features.name: Multi-Format Export & Social Publishing
features.description: One-click 9:16 vertical exports for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels, as well as 16:9 cinematic landscape.
